bundle.shortDescription: A local template library for any text you reuse frequently: AI prompts, email templates, notes and multi-step SOPs.
bundle.longDescription: Castline is a lightweight, local-first desktop library for any reusable text — AI prompts, CLAUDE.md-style notes, message templates and multi-step SOPs. Fill live {{variables}} from reusable profiles and copy with one click.
